name: STARK — Lead Intelligence & Sales Brief Engine

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO leads (source, full_name, company_name, email, phone, website_url, industry, project_requirements, estimated_budget_vnd, lead_score, classification, sales_brief)
VALUES (
  '{{ ($json.source || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.full_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.company_name || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.email || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.phone || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.website_url || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.industry || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.project_requirements || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.estimated_budget_vnd || 0 }},
  {{ $json.lead_score || 60 }},
  '{{ ($json.classification || 'WARM').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ JSON.stringify($json.sales_brief).replace(/'/g, "''") }}'::jsonb
)
RETURNING id, full_name, company_name, lead_score, classification;
